title: THE IMAGE OF DYSFUNCTION OR THE IMAGE OF GOD WHICH ONE ARE YOU?

sense.text:
“Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read”: that is what we have to do, especially in these trying times, with all that is going on in the world, in our nation, our families, our communities and our sanctuaries. We must seek the Lord, and we seek him in the Bible. That is where our direction, our vision and our understanding come from. The Bible is the guideline and the compass of where we need to go; without it we are completely lost and don’t know which way is up. The book of the Lord is no other book on this planet but the Bible.

“no one of these shall fail”: not one of the prophecies in this Bible shall fail. Everything is going to come to pass as the Bible says, not one jot or one tittle passing from the law and the prophets.

“none shall want her mate”: you cannot mate the Bible with any other book. Nobody can bring another book and call it the book of the Lord too; that is garbage. You cannot add to the Bible. The Bible stands alone.

“for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them”: from God’s own mouth he commanded the books to be gathered together. The Lord gathered the books that are in here: so many chapters in the Psalms, so many books to Paul, so many to John. His spirit gathered them together in the books. So what book are we supposed to be reading? The Bible.

“And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line”: he divided it. There were no chapters written at first, the chapters came later, but he gave the books: Moses got five books, and so forth.

“they shall possess it for ever”: the Israelites shall possess the book of the Lord forever. You really have to see how beautiful the Lord is: through all the mess we went through, the Most High made sure the Bible followed us through all our captivities, and behold, we have it. People still talk their doubt about the Bible, but it is still here for you to wake up. Even the Greeks tried to get rid of it, and the Most High put the Spirit on the prophets, Ezra among them, to bring it all the way back up.

“from generation to generation shall they dwell therein”: that means today. Many of us have lost that heritage through our sin, our ignorance and our evil, but the Bible didn’t go anywhere. Your mind went somewhere else: it went into dysfunction and left the Bible alone. You were made in the image of God, and it is time to get your mind right and recognize that.

precepts.why:
The book of the Lord is the only book: “And further, by these, my son, be admonished: of making many books there is no end; and much study is a weariness of the flesh.” Anything outside the Bible that you try to live your life by is a weariness of the flesh. All you will profit from it is getting tired. You might get a good night’s sleep, unless a demon flies out of some book bound in some kind of skin and messes your whole head up.

They are always writing books about what God is going to do on this earth, about his plans, about who his people are and what is going to happen to them. No other book can answer that but the Bible, and much study of the rest of those books is a waste of time.

When we bring a book, it is filtered through the Bible. If it contradicts the Bible, if it goes against the laws, the commandments and the prophecies, it is garbage. A book is brought only to illuminate the reading, to give the sense and cause the people to understand it, using something tangible and relevant to today to help you see the Bible better.

“Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter”: the conclusion of the whole matter is in the Bible, and Daniel 7 shows what it is. Coming back to it: “Fear God, and keep his commandments”. His commandments are found in the book of the Lord, the Bible. You won’t find them in the Quran, or in the Egyptian Book of the Dead, none of that garbage, all that bull’s piss. That is how you know which book is the book of the Lord.

“for this is the whole duty of man”: the image of God is doing what God said. The man spoken of is the Israelite man, because we are the ones who are going to make everybody else dance to the tune of this Bible, but it has to be done by us first. So we are in training, getting ourselves together. That is why we are on this slave ship called America: we broke God’s laws and his commandments. We were not brought over here to join in with this mess; we were brought here to be trained, because we messed up back in the garden with Adam, when we had it all. Now our enemies put the streets on us, and we have to endure all of that to get back home.

sense.text:
“And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven”: the kingdom here is the kingdoms of this whole planet earth. What is under the whole heaven? The planet earth. This verse illuminates verse 9 and gives more detail: when the thrones are cast down, all of it is given to Israel. All the nations are going to have to give all their wealth back to Israel, and not just the materials: they themselves have to come through. You are our property; bring the wealth, bring everything, including you too. He will beautify the meek with salvation.

“shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High”: the saints shall take the kingdom, and it will be left to nobody but the Israelites, as Daniel 2:44 says. “whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom”: our kingdom is an everlasting kingdom that shall never be destroyed.

“and all dominions shall serve and obey him”: every dominion that is alive is going to serve and obey the nation of Israel. Period. They are going to obey, for the Lord shall go forth out of Zion with a rod of iron. That is a beautiful thing too, and that thing is going to hurt.

“Hitherto is the end of the matter.” That is the conclusion of the whole Bible. If you are trying to find out what God’s plan is, the plan of God is for the Israelites to rule this planet indefinitely, with all other dominions serving the righteousness of the Most High through the nation of Israel. Period, point blank, full stop. That is the end of the whole argument, and it is the conclusion of the whole matter that Ecclesiastes points to.

precepts.why:
“I beheld till the thrones were cast down”: thrones with an s, meaning kingdoms, all the kingdoms recorded in this chapter. All the kingdoms of this world are going to be thrown down in Armageddon, when Christ comes back to smash, kill and destroy and set his people up in rulership. Daniel stood by and watched the kingdoms that arise out of the earth, but the saints of the Lord shall take the kingdom. That is going to be a magnificent thing, and we want to be there to see it.

“and the Ancient of days did sit”: God sat down. If he sat down, he has a body: legs, arms and a head. “whose garment was white as snow”: if the Ancient of days had a garment on, he has a body. “and the hair of his head like the pure wool”: the hair on God’s head was like the pure wool. Black people. How you like me now?

So the lies they paint in your Bibles and in your churches, God looking like a so-called Caucasian, are not the Bible. And verse 27 only gives more detail to what verse 9 shows: the thrones of this world cast down, and the kingdom under the whole heaven given to the saints.

That kingdom is everlasting because Daniel says so here: “And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed”. These are the same kings. The kingdom the God of heaven sets up is you, sisters and brothers, the nation of Israel, and it is set up in the days of these kings, meaning it is starting now. A lot of people don’t like that, but the Most High is building this kingdom right now, in the age of their decadence.

“and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms”: the Most High’s kingdom, the nation of Israel, with Christ, the Most High and the angels leading us, shall break the nations and make them bend to the will of God, or death. We are going to consume all the kingdoms. Everybody is going to be made to follow the laws and commandments of this Bible. Full stop.

“and it shall stand for ever.” Remember these words: the kingdom the Lord is setting up shall stand forever. We are supposed to be in the image of understanding that, not in the image of dysfunction.

“Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people”. The place where it was said is the place where we were made to be dysfunctional, where we were made a mess, called coon, spear-chucker, wetback, every name. That is what they said about us: they called us everything except the Israelites.

The Lord is going to punish the nations for that, because we are God’s heritage. Those that put their nasty, mangy, urine-infested hands on us touched the apple of his eye, and they are definitely going to pay for it. Our brothers and sisters were hung and put through all kinds of evil, but the Most High has the chart on everything. He is allowing it to happen, but he is still going to make them pay for doing it.

And in that same place the Most High is going to beautify the meek with salvation: there we shall be called the sons and daughters of God, and all the garbage and rubbish they put on us is not the real us.

Who can resist God’s will? That was the argument in Romans 9, where the Lord said he hated Esau. “For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up”: the same purpose for which he raised up Pharaoh is the purpose for which he is raising up Esau. “that I might shew my power in thee”: that God might show his power by channeling his powerful, destructive anger through him, tearing his butt up. “and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth”: the Lord is going to get his glory by destroying the man everybody is worshipping, and they will all see the Most High as the real power. He did Pharaoh that way, and he is going to do Esau the same way.

“Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.” He raised up Pharaoh to make Pharaoh resist God, and he makes Esau do the same thing, with the eagle and all of it. He is fattening Esau up, giving him all the weapons, the technology and the power, getting him pumped up with pride, the way they fatten a turkey for their wicked holidays. Then he cuts him down.

“Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?” How can he find fault with the man when he gave him all the weapons and made him resist? That is how some of the churches act. But Esau cannot resist the will of God, and Pharaoh could not either. Pharaoh wanted to let the Israelites go, and the Lord hardened his heart, because he would have got off too easy. God wanted him to be as bad and as wicked as he could be, so that when he is destroyed everybody will know that he is God and besides him there is no other. That is what he is doing to Esau.

“Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God?” In other words, shut the hell up; shut your damn mouth. I made him, I am going to destroy him, and you better be glad I am not looking at you yet. “Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?” God formed Esau to be the fitting jacket for his destruction. You can’t change that: he was fitted for God’s destruction, and the galactic battle that is coming is God setting it up. The Most High made one vessel to drink wine out of and another to move his bowels in; the one made for the bowel movement can’t ask why it wasn’t made a cup to drink out of. It is that simple.

You better be glad you are an Israelite. A lot of our people are complaining and acting crazy, and they will be destroyed with their enemies. Our people went through slavery, Jim Crow, lynchings, burnings, drownings, blunt force trauma, blackface, a whole journey of complete hell in this kingdom. To go through all of that and then get to the end and die with the same man that did it to you is crazy.

sense.text:
“Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire”: the smith is the one who makes weapons, the blacksmith who made swords, shields and bucklers in the old times. The smith today is the scientist: Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, the companies that make weapons. Oppenheimer. The Most High made him build that thing. He did not want to make it, and the Lord said, make the damn thing anyway. They will build the button, and they might not want to press it, but God is going to make them press it. Who can resist God’s will? This is coming down, brothers and sisters.

“and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work”: the instrument today is not a regular sword, buckler or shield. It is a bomb, a missile. And it is for his work, the work of the Lord.

“and I have created the waster to destroy”: that is crystal clear, a nuclear bomb that the Lord himself caused to be built. The weapon of their destruction is already here, and they can do nothing against it. That is the power of the Lord. The Bible is everything. We had better be glad we are on his side, and those of us still playing games and messing around had better wake up quick.

“No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper”: even the bomb itself is not going to prosper against us. And no weapon means the psychological weapons too: everything our enemies are doing to destroy us, none of it will prosper. The Lord said he will save his people.

Those psychological weapons are what have so many of us in an image of dysfunction, and they show how much work we have to do to save our children, our families, our brothers and our sisters. Our people are caught up because they don’t know what we know: they have been bamboozled, tricked, hoodwinked and indoctrinated, and they are catching hell and don’t know why. We were once taken advantage of too, but we woke up. Our job is to open their minds, bring them out of the dysfunction and back to the image of God, and we have to do that within ourselves first and present that image so they can see what the image of God really is.

“and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn.” That is the point: we are going to win this thing if we do right by the Lord.

precepts.why:
The weapon not prospering is in the Psalm read in the opening prayer: “Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.” That means we are going to be taken up while those bombs are destroying our enemies right beneath us. Only with our eyes will we see them burn and die. That is a beautiful thing.

It is for those in the first verse: “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” The secret place of the Most High, to make it simple, is his commandments. So none of the weapons they create is actually going to affect us.

sense.text: “A city is builded, and set upon a broad field, and is full of all good things”: the city is the kingdom. That is what we are trying to get to.

“The entrance thereof is narrow, and is set in a dangerous place to fall, like as if there were a fire on the right hand, and on the left a deep water”: we have to go through tribulation to get there, through the narrow passages, entering in at the strait gate, because we messed up.

The fire and the deep water are the affliction our enemies put on us. If we did not have to be buffeted by our enemies, our journey would be quite smooth. But don’t get twisted: God set it up that way, because we messed up from the beginning. Now we have to serve them, and they are going to make it hell for us to get the kingdom.

“And one only path between them both, even between the fire and the water”: the temptations we allow our enemies to put us in, the tricks, the traps, all the things coming from our enemies to beset us and knock us off our path to glory, because we messed up with the Lord. “so small that there could but one man go there at once.”

“If this city now were given unto a man for an inheritance, if he never shall pass the danger set before it, how shall he receive this inheritance?” The Most High is going to make us work for this kingdom. All that is happening to us is because the Most High is trying us: all the psychological traps, some terrible evils, some very vicious things, and we have to endure through all of it.

“Even so also is Israel’s portion.” This is our portion, because we messed up. We weren’t the Israelites per se back with Adam, but the righteous seed of the Israelites came from Adam, so we sinned all the way from back then. Eve was our foremother and Adam our forefather.

“Because for their sakes I made the world: and when Adam transgressed my statutes, then was decreed that now is done.” This is why we have to go through this narrow passage. Then were the straits decreed, all the hardships: through much tribulation shall we enter the kingdom.

The woman goes through pain in childbirth because of the disobedience back then. She didn’t want to listen to Adam, Adam let her bamboozle him, and then he tried to blame it on the woman God gave him, when he was supposed to put her in check. But it is not only the labour pains: the psychological problems, the family problems, brothers hating brothers, all of that is pressed upon us too.

“Then were the entrances of this world made narrow, full of sorrow and travail”: psychological sorrows and travails. The problems in our communities, what is happening with our children, the gangs, our children being snuffed out: all of it is very painful. It ain’t just the labour pains; it is everything else with it.

“they are but few and evil, full of perils”, “and very painful.” We are going to go through a lot of traumatic things, and that trauma is what has caused us to be dysfunctional. We have to fight through all of that dysfunction and come back to the image of God.

“For the entrances of the elder world were wide and sure, and brought immortal fruit.” That was before we messed up. It was all given to us, and we didn’t die. Imagine that. If the nations were not here besetting us, it would almost be like that; a lot of what comes against us is because our enemies have been turned on us. Thou shalt serve thine enemies: the Most High said that. That is what makes our lives feel like a living hell, and we have to fight through it.

“If then they that live labour not to enter these strait and vain things, they can never receive those that are laid up for them.” If we don’t go through these straits, if we don’t go through these problems and fix them, we can never just walk into the kingdom. The Most High doesn’t want us to give up; he wants us to go through it, fix it and endure. Who will commit to our trust the true riches if we cannot get our things together right now and deal with what the Most High justly put on us because we messed up with him?

precepts.why:
The fire and the deep water are the nations. “Now these are the nations which the Lord left, to prove Israel by them”: he didn’t get rid of all the nations. He left some there, because he doesn’t want us to just skate through; we have to learn some things. “even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan”: so when we get into the kingdom we are going to be experts in everything. We are getting the training now.

Captivity and persecution are hard and rough; nobody wants to go through these things. They can kill the body and do all kinds of evil to it, but they cannot kill the spirit, and when we come back, we are going to hang their ass. You have to keep the vision of the kingdom in your mind regardless of what is thrown at you. That is the mindset it takes to persevere between the fire on one side and the deep water on the other: the nations afflicting us.

“Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof”: that is what will make us perfect when we get into the kingdom. We will have done it all and know it all. We didn’t know about war before; now we will know it all, because we are going to endure it and make it through.

sense.text:
Christ said you must deny yourself. The you that does the denying is the part God is dealing with; the self is the composite of the conditioning you were made into. You have to check it against how you were made: examine your own thoughts and your own behaviours, and ask yourself, why am I behaving like this? Is this the real me, or is this a response to what I have been conditioned to be?

“For that which I do I allow not”: what I end up doing because of conditioning, the real me, my spirit, does not allow. “for what I would, that do I not”: what my spirit would want to do, I don’t do, because the conditioned person says don’t follow the righteousness of your real spirit. That is the duality that goes on with us every day.

“but what I hate, that do I”: the real me, the righteous part of me that is connected to God, hates evil, and I end up doing it because I am acting in response to conditioning and not by what the Lord made me to be.

“If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.” That is the fight, brothers and sisters. There is a duality, and the real us has to step forward.

The conditioned us is the man out in front, the mask we show the world. The real soul of us is buried, hiding, scared. Most of the time, dealing with our people, you are dealing with the mask, the representative, while the real them is still scared down in the bottom of their shoes. We have to encourage that real spirit to come forward and be the image God made, rather than the conditioning you see in the mask.

Every person must confront a foundational question: am I who I was created to be, or what I was conditioned to become? It is not a surface question but an identity question, about the real soul of a man and the real soul of a woman. Everything about us, our patterns, our responses, our beliefs, our defences, has been shaped by one of two forces: creation or conditioning. Creation speaks to design: God saying, I want you here. Conditioning speaks to experience: making a slave of a man or a woman and making them think that is what they innately are. That is the Negro made in a lab. The real him has not stood up yet; the greatness in us is buried under self-doubt, living under a tarp of trauma, lies, deceit, trickery and psychological hang-ups.

One is intentional, the other is reactive, and we are reactive people. One reflects origin, the image God made; the other reflects adaptation: adapting to slavery, to being taken advantage of, to ghettos, to being unclean, a gang member, a drug addict. That is not who we really are. Our job is to distinguish between what we have been made into and who we truly are.

“So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him”. You were created with intention, not randomly formed, not by accident, not undefined in purpose. You did have purpose; you just lost your way. This is the original declaration, not only about humanity in general but about you specifically, the real soul of man and woman. Not what they try to tell you that you are, a whore, a drug addict, a drug dealer. You were made in the image of God, not in the image of your dysfunction, not in the image of your traumatic experiences, an unstable childhood, an abusive relationship, or an environment that never reflected your worth back to you.

They tell us we are everything except the children of God, but as Hosea showed, in the place where it was said ye are not my people, there we shall be called the sons and daughters of God. We are not what you say we are; we are what God said we are. Carry yourselves that way and teach it to your children, because this damn world will turn them upside down if you are not 100% serious about it.

Before the false self was constructed, there was an image, an original design, and that design carries attributes: the capacity for creativity, for dominion, for fruitfulness. People can’t believe we can do things because they still live with a dysfunctional mind. Men and women, regardless of what you went through, you can fix it. These attributes are not just aspirational, like some novel we read about; they are original, in our DNA, placed within you by God before the world opened its lips to say anything.

“Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it”: replenish the earth means have babies. Part of the woman’s makeup is bearing children; it is a natural thing, so why would that be a problem? It is hard because nothing is in place to help her once the baby is born. Sisters hate each other, brothers hate women, women hate men, and yet they have sex and get pregnant; then they don’t want the baby, and the child is left with all these negative feelings about itself, creating more dysfunction. When white people have babies, the whole family is in the waiting area celebrating; when our people have babies, a note comes down saying don’t let the father up, and sometimes another dude who thought the baby was his is fighting the father on the damn maternity floor. The mother goes home alone. That is not depression per se; that is a messed up society that has made having children a problem, and that is totally unnatural.

It is up to us as men to build the framework and the network: groups of sisters, midwives, programs, a community around her so that when she brings forth fruit she brings it forth in a good way, with protection. That is how it was in the past, and we have to get back to it. Don’t blame the children: a righteous child is a gift from the Lord.

“and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth”: the capacity for dominion, to rule, was placed in us from the beginning.

precepts.why:
What God placed in us was placed before the world had its say, and the world is not to have its say against us at all: “But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue, against man or beast”. Are we the children of Israel, brothers? Sisters? Then not a dog shall open his black lips or his pink lips or any lips against us, or against anything that belongs to us. Shut your damn mouth.

“that ye may know how that the Lord doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel”: the Lord put a difference so the world may know. We are his holy jewels, the jewelry God is going to wear around his neck, the apple of his eye.

So carry yourselves like that, and the hell with people telling you you can’t boast. Even in captivity, it is only temporary: I am not the fruition of what they did to me, and a day is coming when everything that ever spoke against our people faces judgment. They say you don’t talk like a slave; that’s because I’m not one. Be like Christ: they put him on the cross, but he knew he could call down legions with a bat of his eye, because he already knew he had the power, and we are to be joint heirs with him. The world is scared to death of us coming into that connection.

“This people have I formed for myself”: the Israelites. “they shall shew forth my praise”: so all the other nations are going to catch hell.

Put that in your spirit and in your children’s spirit. Teach your children that they are superior, because they are. They show you Superman and Batman and make you think you are nothing but criminals, and when we teach the reverse they use the Jedi mind trick to make us think we are doing something wrong. The hell with you and your damn thoughts. That is why these sons need fathers, sisters: fathers in the household who think like that, so the sons grow up in the right posture.

You were not formed for survival, or to be a product of your environment. You were formed for a purpose that originates outside your circumstances, connected to the nature and intent of the Most High who formed you. That is what being made in the image of God means.

“Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee”: before the sperm and the egg came together, you already existed and were known by the Most High. You were spiritual with him, and he said, now I want you to go down and be the son of so and so, the daughter of so and so. That was decided in the heavens. Millions race to that egg, each a different spirit, and the Lord says, I want this one rather than that one, as he brought forth Jeremiah. There is a reason God chose you to be here instead of someone else. You are not here just because; you are here by direct action from God, and you must find out what that purpose is.

“and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee, and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations.” Whatever the Lord ordained us to be, we are going to be. He made us the children of Israel and gave us talents, and that is why organizing those talents matters so much: we are not going to waste what God made. Nobody gives a damn how much you doubt yourselves; get that doubt out of here and let the real you be built up.

sense.text:
Where did the conditioning come in, that made us into a dysfunctional byproduct of what we really are? It came through our enemies, and here is part of the key to getting out of this whole mess. This is our history being run down to Holofernes by his captain, who knew the whole history of Israel from the very beginning up to the time of the Persians.

“And whilst they sinned not before their God, they prospered, because the God that hateth iniquity was with them.” Whenever we keep God’s commandments, we prosper. So the objective of our enemies is to make us not obey God, to keep us in dysfunction so they can keep dominating us. They want the body and the brilliant mind, but they don’t want us using that mind for ourselves, so they set psychological traps so that we work for them instead of building ourselves.

The nations are terrified that we are learning and teaching this Bible. World leaders and committees are trying to destroy what we are doing; an official of the Israeli government came to Atlanta, meeting with AIPAC and the ADL, saying the number one threat was the black men leading, not Hamas, not Hezbollah, but the blacks in this country. They know the prophecy. The bastards do read.

“But when they departed from the way which he appointed them, they were destroyed in many battles very sore”: that is what the nations want, us disconnected from our God and from the image of our God. Then they give us an image of dysfunction and tell us that is who we really are, a composite of what they have done to us. That is how we are being destroyed today. Look at the mess our people are in.

“and were led captives into a land that was not their’s, and the temple of their God was cast to the ground, and their cities were taken by the enemies”: this is history. The Babylonians came in, cast our temple down and took our cities, and said rase it, rase it even to the foundation thereof, as Psalm 137 tells.

“But now are they returned to their God”: this is the time of the Persians, the time of Ezra, when Cyrus granted Israel liberty to go back and build. Holofernes asked who that people on the hill was, and why they weren’t coming to worship him, and his captain told him: those are the Israelites, and if they are keeping God’s laws, leave them the hell alone.

“and are come up from the places where they were scattered”: out of captivity. We were in the Assyrian captivity first; then Babylon threw down Assyria and we were in the Babylonian captivity; then the Lord let the Persians under Cyrus take down Babylon, and Cyrus proclaimed that he would let Israel go back and build. “for it was desolate”: we had to go back and rebuild it. This is right before what the Apocrypha tells of the tribes coming over here.

“Now therefore, my lord and governor, if there be any error against this people, and they sin against their God, let us consider that this shall be their ruin”: here is the key. He was telling Holofernes how to subdue us: if they are not keeping the commandments of God, you can throw them down. That is exactly what is happening to us now. The objective of our enemies is to keep us in ruin, and they do it by keeping us outside our commandments. “and let us go up, and we shall overcome them.”

“But if there be no iniquity in their nation, let my lord now pass by”: if there is no sin in our nation, with us checking each other and making sure we are all good, they said leave them the hell alone. That is where our power is. “lest their Lord defend them, and their God be for them, and we become a reproach before all the world”: we are the apple of his eye, and whoever puts their filthy fat fingers on God’s people while they keep his commandments becomes a reproach, a fool in history, like Pharaoh, and as he will do Esau.

That is why they want us subdued and dysfunctional: so we cannot organize the greatness the Lord put in us by nature. They didn’t grab people who knew nothing to build this country; it is what it is because we are here. Black men came from a country where they were warriors and family heads, and in the Ghanaian states were kings, princes, governors, generals, judges, architects, engineers, doctors, mathematicians, goldsmiths, blacksmiths, an industrious and skillful people. So they built a slave system designed to destroy the manhood of the black male, killing the sons in the mind first. We are not niggas, not coons, not Ham; that lie was given to us to make us think we are a different image than what God made. Even cut off from everything, with no money, no 40 acres, no mule, we built Black Wall Street in Tulsa, in Durham, in Rosewood, with our own hospitals, hotels and theaters, and they got mad and bombed it. They know how great a resource we are.

So how do we get back to the image of God? The key is written here: no iniquity in the nation. Start now, right where you are, with what you have; IUIC started in a basement. The seed to start with is divesting from these wicked, demonic holidays, these wicked ass holidays God is not even a part of. If we are tired of the Nolan Wells situations and the Rasheem Carter situations, then come Christmas, Thanksgiving, Easter, Halloween, the 4th of July, all twelve tribes, we buy nothing. Shut all of that shit down. Keep your damn money in your pocket, or better yet, support this truth. Let the chocolate bunnies melt on the shelf. Keep the Sabbath, the new moon and all of God’s high holy days instead, and say, Lord, we are keeping your commandments. The closer we get to God, the more our enemies will catch hell, because God will be on our side.
“Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.” We need to add this to our prayers.

“For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult”: they are our enemies too, but they are God’s enemies. “and they that hate thee have lifted up the head”: they have lifted up their heads against the Most High and against everything that is about the Most High.

“They have taken crafty counsel against thy people”: setting up a dysfunctional society that makes you absolutely adverse to what God made you. AIPAC counsel, The Israel Project counsel, the ADL counsel, the Canary Mission counsel: crafty counsel against the people of the Lord. “and consulted against thy hidden ones”: consultation means secret meetings, counsel held against us.

“They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation”: when they come together in their meetings, the discussion is to cut us off from the Most High, from who we truly are, from the image of God, and to morph us into the image of dysfunction. Yes, you and I are the subject of their evil secret councils.

“that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance”: their counsel is to make sure we don’t know we are the Israelites. They are not doing that to those bastards over there; they are doing it to us, because we are the Israelites. This is crystal clear, and the Israeli official saying it on American soil shows these secret councils are not jive: they are literally talking about us.

Our enemies do a deep search into what works on us on a psychological level; this is what they are actually plotting in the secret council. “Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.”

“Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked”: hide us from the secret plots of AIPAC, of the ADL, all of them bastards. Make their hands turn against them; make their plans fall on them. “from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity”: the workers of sin, a bunch of evil, wicked, nasty people.

“Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words”: they lie on us and call us anti-Semitic. The word Semite comes from Shem; the Chinese, the Arabs, we are Semitic, the white man is Semitic. How can we be anti-Semitic when we are Semitic ourselves? And where were those devils when Shem was born? They came down from Isaac and Rebekah: Esau. We’ve been here.
“That they may shoot in secret at the perfect”: we are the perfect, and they shoot in secret by lying about us. “suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.”

“They encourage themselves in an evil matter”: when they sit in those councils, they encourage one another in evil, plotting how to destroy us, our children and our women in the hospitals, to bring complete hell and destruction on our people. And we have to endure through all of it. “they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?”

“They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.” They think deep on how to psychologically trap us into perpetuating our own destruction: getting us to attack ourselves by imaging ourselves as nothing, so they no longer have to enforce it on us. That is why they love to find one of our silly, simple brothers, put him in a dress and parade him out, saying look at what your people are doing; why they strip our women, who could be somebody’s mother, and say look at your woman. It is to shame us and make us feel bad about ourselves.

They have us walking around with our pants hanging down, and our women showing off their physical assets because their spiritual assets are vacant. They want us as clowns running up and down the court and the gridiron, acting a fool on stage, knowing nothing of our history, our nation or the achievements of our ancestors. That behavior tells the world we are worthy to be mistreated. We are taught to hate ourselves, and as a man is made to think, he becomes what he sees himself as. That is why we must change how we see ourselves and each other to break this curse.

So we have a lot of work to do. But we are men, and if we as men don’t do it, it won’t be done. No other people is coming to do our job, and if we see ourselves connected to the Most High, why are we looking for anybody else to do what we ourselves are capable of doing?

The squeaky wheel gets the oil: the one who speaks up the loudest is the one who gets attention, help or results, and when we are too quiet, that is what allows us to be abused. They don’t like when we talk, when we prophesy, when we seek the welfare of our people. That is why they put such a heavy lid on rap music: when it was talking conscious, Public Enemy, KRS-One, Lakim Shabazz, Professor Griff, they pushed the gangster foolishness instead.

“I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem”: the watchmen pay attention to the condition of the people and to the enemy coming to destroy the people; they are there to watch out and look out. “which shall never hold their peace day nor night”: we are going to complain, bring out the records, judge, and tell it like it is. We are not being silent; silence is not a man.

“ye that make mention of the Lord, keep not silence”: that wheel is squeaking, squeaking like hell, getting on your damn nerves.

“And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.” We are not giving the Lord any rest. We will keep begging the Lord until he kills our enemies and sets us up, like the woman who kept coming to the unjust judge until he had to avenge her.

Our enemies don’t want us to beg or cry to the Lord. They want us silent, locked away with our mouths zipped: on social media, community guidelines block the word of God while every filth goes untouched. Quiet people are passed over; we want the Most High to take action. They say we are causing problems. Yes, we are causing problems, because you are not supposed to be over us. They want a quiet slave. The hell with you.

Don’t let him think about anything serious, because then he becomes a danger: that is the exact reason we are encouraged to be sports figures, entertainers, dancers, to frolic, to play, jump and move about in a happy, carefree way, with nothing analytical. The white mother takes her son to the craft shop to buy an airplane he has to build himself; the black family buys it already assembled. One family raises a consumer, the other teaches its sons to run the world. Constant frolic is a false image of being comfortable in slavery: he makes billions running up and down the court and thinks he has made it, but has nothing to do with running our own banks or our own medical centers.

“For fear is nothing else but a betraying of the succours which reason offereth.” The succours are comforts: it is a betraying comfort. You think you are comfortable in your sports or your lofty position, but the real soul of you knows you are still a slave, and you hold to that betraying comfort because you are afraid to do what Kaepernick did. He caught the fever, saw what was happening to his people and got serious, and you saw how they went after him. His teammates knew he did the right thing, but they had to pretend they were all right. That is portraying comfort.

So because of fear we stay in that mess and never stand up to be men, lying to ourselves that we are comfortable being a clown. We cannot drown out the horrible squeaking of our wretched condition, the psychological traumas we live through, with frolic, drugs, alcohol, music or the cell phone. We cannot be dancing slaves made to look whole while inside there is an ongoing spiritual rot of decadence that we can no longer afford.

That is the seasoning: the system by which strong men and women were broken and remade into an image pleasing to the oppressor. They made us dance on the slave ships. If we look happy, they can present us to the world as not mistreated: look, a happy slave, a grown man on a damn table like a damn monkey, dancing for these damn white folks, begging for some damn record deal. That imagery hurts a young son looking up, trying to aspire to something greater. It is a betraying comfort; it ain’t no comfort at all.

Painkillers deal with the pain but never with its cause. Drugs, alcohol, dumb sitcoms, social media, and Christianity too, getting high on the drums, the tambourines and the damn Hammond organ, make us feel good for the moment, but we come back out and our homes are still broken, our children out of order, our men sent to jail in record numbers. You have to go to the source of the problem: to the actual image of yourself. We must break this cycle and emancipate ourselves from the mental slavery, which will ultimately emancipate us from the physical slavery, because once we get our minds right, the Lord is going to step in.
